mapper.select: SELECT ar.* FROM activity_registration ar WHERE ar.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ar.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id AS activityId, a.title AS activityTitle, COUNT(ar.id) AS totalRegistrations, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.signed_in = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS signedInCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.checked_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checkedOutCount FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_registration ar ON a.id = ar.activity_id AND ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE a.id = #{activityId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY a.id, a.title

SELECT ar.id AS registrationId, ar.user_id AS userId, u.real_name AS userName, ar.phone, ar.signed_in AS signedIn, ar.sign_time AS signTime, ar.checked_out AS checkedOut, ar.checkout_time AS checkoutTime, ar.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes, ar.remark FROM activity_registration ar LEFT JOIN user u ON ar.user_id = u.id WHERE ar.activity_id = #{activityId} AND ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY ar.create_time DESC
